questions.question: The average monthly expenditure of a family was Rs. 2,500 during the first 4 months, Rs. 2,750 during the next 5 months and Rs. 3,550 during the last 3 months of a year. If the total saving during the year was Rs. 5,500, what was the average monthly income of the family?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

First 4 month average monthly expenditure of a family = 2,500 Rs.

Next 5 month average monthly expenditure of a family = 2,750 Rs.

Last 3 month average monthly expenditure of a family = 3,550 Rs.

Total saving of a family during a year = 5,500 Rs.

**Concept Use :-**

Average = {Sum} ~of ~all~ the ~quantity over Total ~number ~of ~quantity

Income = Saving + Expenditure

**Calculation :-**

⇒ First 4 month total expenditure of a family = (First 4 month average monthly expenditure of a family ) × (Number of month)

⇒ First 4 month total expenditure of a family = (2500 Rs) ×( 4 ) = 10,000 Rs.

⇒ Next 5 month total expenditure of a family = (Next 5 month average monthly expenditure of a family) × (Number of month)

⇒ Next 5 month total expenditure of a family = (2750 Rs) × (5) = 13,750 Rs.

⇒ Last 3 month total expenditure of a family = (Last 3 month average monthly expenditure of a family) × (Number of month)

⇒ Last 3 month total expenditure of a family = (3550 Rs) × (3) = 10,650 Rs.

Now,

⇒ Total Income of a family in a year = (Total saving of a family during a year ) + (First 4 month total expenditure of a family) + ( Next 5 month total expenditure of a family) + ( Last 3 month total expenditure of a family)

⇒ Total Income of a family in a year = 5,500 Rs + 10,000 Rs + 13,750 Rs + 10,650 Rs = 39,900 Rs.

⇒ Average monthly income of a family = (Total Income of a family in a year) / (Total number of month in a year)

⇒ Average monthly income of a family = 39900/12 = **3325 Rs**

questions.question: Moving at (6)/(7) of its usual speed, a bus is 20 minutes late. What is its usual time to cover the journey?
questions.solution:

Moving at (6)/(7) of its usual speed, a bus is 20 minutes late.

**Concept Use :-**

Speed = Distance over Time

Let,

Usual time 'T',Speed 's',Distance 'D'

⇒ New time =( T + 20/60) hr

⇒ D =( 6S/7) × (T + 20/60) ..............(2)

Now,

From equation (1) and (2)

⇒ S × T = (6S/7) × (T + 20/60 )

⇒ S × 7/6S = (T + 20/60 ) / T

⇒ 7/6 = 1 +1/3T

⇒( 7/6) - 1 = 1/3T

⇒ 1/6 = 1/3T

⇒ 3T = 6

questions.question: If ΔABC and ΔPQR are similar. AB = 8 cm, PQ = 12 cm, QR = 18 cm and RP = 24 cm, then the perimeter of ΔABC is _________ cm.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Perimeter of ΔPQR = PQ + QR + RP = 12 + 18 + 24 = 54 cm

Ratio of corresponding sides = AB / PQ = 8 / 12 = 2 / 3

Perimeter of ΔABC = 54 × (2 / 3) = 36 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

AB = 8 cm

PQ = 12 cm

QR = 18 cm

RP = 24 cm

ΔABC ~ ΔPQR

**Formula Used:**

For two similar triangles, the ratio of their perimeters is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides:

Perimeter(ΔABC) / Perimeter(ΔPQR) = AB / PQ = BC / QR = CA / RP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c915b7e6c39814636414cedc3eaca66decb41a196ad73642c855739f7673ffdb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Perimeter of ΔPQR = PQ + QR + RP

⇒ Perimeter of ΔPQR = 12 + 18 + 24 = 54 cm

⇒ Perimeter(ΔABC) / Perimeter(ΔPQR) = AB / PQ

⇒ Perimeter(ΔABC) / 54 = 8 / 12

⇒ Perimeter(ΔABC) / 54 = 2 / 3

⇒ Perimeter(ΔABC) = 54 × (2 / 3)

⇒ Perimeter(ΔABC) = 18 × 2 = 36 cm

**Option Analysis:**

**Option (1) 36:** This is the correct perimeter of ΔABC as calculated above.

**Option (2) 54:** This is the perimeter of ΔPQR, not ΔABC.

**Option (3) 27:** This value is incorrect because the ratio of perimeters must be 2:3, which gives 36 cm, not 27 cm.

**Option (4) 42:** This value is incorrect because it does not satisfy the similarity ratio of 2:3 with the perimeter of ΔPQR (54 cm).

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Properties of Similar Triangles

If two triangles are similar, the ratio of their corresponding sides is equal to the ratio of their perimeters, altitudes, medians, and angle bisectors.

Area Ratio Theorem

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area(ΔABC) / Area(ΔPQR) = (AB / PQ)².

Criteria for Similarity

Two triangles are similar if they satisfy any of the following criteria: Angle-Angle (AA), Side-Angle-Side (SAS), or Side-Side-Side (SSS).</p

questions.question: 47 masons can dig a 35 m long trench in one day. How many masons should be employed for digging a 105 m long trench of the same type in one day?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the time remains constant (1 day), the number of masons is directly proportional to the length of the trench.

Work ratio = 105 m ÷ 35 m = 3

Therefore, required masons = Initial masons × 3

Required masons = 47 × 3 = 141

**∴ The correct answer is 141 masons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial masons (M₁) = 47

Initial trench length (W₁) = 35 m

Initial days (D₁) = 1 day

Final trench length (W₂) = 105 m

Final days (D₂) = 1 day

**Formula Used:**

MDH Rule: (M₁ × D₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) ÷ W₂

 
 Work = 35 m
 
 
 47 Masons
 
 
 Work = 105 m
 
 
 141 Masons

**Calculation:**

⇒ (47 × 1) ÷ 35 = (M₂ × 1) ÷ 105

⇒ 47 ÷ 35 = M₂ ÷ 105

⇒ M₂ = (47 × 105) ÷ 35

⇒ M₂ = 47 × 3

⇒ M₂ = 141

**∴ The correct answer is 141 masons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

The relationship between Men (M), Days (D), Hours (H), and Work (W) is given by (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

Direct Proportion

If two quantities are directly related (e.g., Work and Men), an increase in one results in a proportional increase in the other. In this case, M ∝ W.

Inverse Proportion

If two quantities are inversely related (e.g., Men and Days), an increase in one results in a proportional decrease in the other. In that case, M ∝ 1 ÷ D.

questions.question: The distance between the centres of two circles of radii 4 cm and 2 cm is 10 cm. The length (in cm) of a transverse common tangent is:
questions.solution:
**Given :-**

The distance between the centres of two circles of radii 4 cm and 2 cm is 10 cm

**Concept Use :-**

 Length of a transverse common tangent = √(d² - ( r1 +r2)²)

where d is the distance b/w the centers of two circle , r1 and r2 is radius of circle

**Calculation :-**

⇒ Length of a transverse common tangent = √(d2 - ( r1 +r2)2)

⇒ Length of a transverse common tangent = √[(10)² - (4 + 2)²]

⇒ Length of a transverse common tangent = √(100 -36) = √64 = 8 cm

⇒ Length of a transverse common tangent = **8cm**

questions.question: The sum of the five consecutive even numbers is 2720. The sum of the third and fifth numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **odd number** of terms in an **Arithmetic Progression** (like consecutive even numbers), the **Average** is always the **Middle term**.

**Average** (3rd number) = Total Sum ÷ Number of terms = 2720 ÷ 5 = 544

Since the numbers are **consecutive even**, the common difference is 2.

5th number = 3rd number + (2 × 2) = 544 + 4 = 548

Required Sum = 3rd number + 5th number = 544 + 548 = 1092

**∴ The correct answer is 1092.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of 5 consecutive even numbers = 2720.

Let the **five consecutive even numbers** be x, x + 2, x + 4, x + 6, and x + 8.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8398f3397adeb7c279c3730d0d2a16ac409d4773c1d763a8d6cf7abbd5742d5d.png] 

⇒ Sum = x + (x + 2) + (x + 4) + (x + 6) + (x + 8) = 2720

⇒ 5x + 20 = 2720

⇒ 5x = 2720 − 20

⇒ 5x = 2700

⇒ x = 2700 ÷ 5 = 540

The numbers are:

3rd number = x + 4 = 540 + 4 = 544

5th number = x + 8 = 540 + 8 = 548

⇒ Required Sum = 544 + 548 = 1092

**∴ The correct answer is 1092.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Even/Odd Numbers

Consecutive even or odd numbers always have a **constant difference** of 2, forming an **Arithmetic Progression**.

Average of AP

For an AP with 'n' terms, Average = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2. If 'n' is odd, the average is exactly the **middle term**.

Sum of First n Even Numbers

The sum of the first 'n' consecutive even numbers starting from 2 is given by the formula: **Sₙ = n(n + 1)**.</p

questions.question: From the salary of a software engineer, if 15% is used as house rent, 25% of the remaining is spent on household items, 25% of the remaining as income tax, and 15% of the remaining on clothing, then he is left with Rs. 10,404. Find his total salary.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **total salary** be 100%.

Remaining salary after all deductions ⇒ 100 × (85/100) × (75/100) × (75/100) × (85/100) = 10,404

Total Salary = 10,404 × (100/85) × (100/75) × (100/75) × (100/85)

Total Salary = 10,404 × (20/17) × (4/3) × (4/3) × (20/17) = 25,600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 25,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

House Rent = 15% | Household = 25% (Remaining) | Tax = 25% (Remaining) | Clothing = 15% (Remaining)

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (100 − r₁)/100 × (100 − r₂)/100 ...

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total salary be **S**.

⇒ S × (1 − 0.15) × (1 − 0.25) × (1 − 0.25) × (1 − 0.15) = 10,404

⇒ S × (0.85) × (0.75) × (0.75) × (0.85) = 10,404

⇒ S × (17/20) × (3/4) × (3/4) × (17/20) = 10,404

⇒ S × (26,01/64,00) = 10,404

⇒ S = (10,404 × 6400) ÷ 2601

⇒ S = 4 × 6400 = 25,600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 25,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When values are deducted from the **remaining balance**, we use the multiplying factor (100 − r)/100 for each step.

Base Change Rule

If expenses are given as a % of the **total**, they are simply added; if given as a % of **remaining**, they are multiplied.</p

questions.question: The simple interest on a sum of money for 1(1)/(2) years at 10% per annum is Rs. 30 more than the simple interest on the same sum for 1 year at 12% per annum. Find the sum.

Difference in interest = Rs. 30

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × r × t) / 100

SI₁ = (P × 10 &

questions.question: If 70% of the cost price of an article is equal to 40% of its selling price, what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given :-**

70% of the cost price of an article is equal to 40% of its selling price.

**Concept Use :-**

Profit (p) = Selling price (s.p) - Cost price (c.p)

p% = (p/c.p) × 100

**Calculation :-**

Let c.p and s.p is x and y

⇒ p = s.p - c.p ..........(1)

⇒ 70% × c.p = 40% × s.p [ According to question ]

⇒ (70/100) × x =(40/100) × y

⇒ 7x = 4y 

⇒ y = 7x/4

Now,

Put the value of y in equation (1)

⇒ p = (7x/4) - x 

⇒ p = 3x/4

Now, 

⇒ p% = (3x/4/x) × 100

⇒ p% = **75%**

**Alternate Method :-**

⇒ 70% × c.p = 40% × s.p

⇒ s.p/c.p = 70%/40%

⇒ p% = (30/40) × 100

⇒ p% =** 75%**
